_about: Every receipt field a public film page may read, and nothing else. summary.ts reads the receipt only through this list (an unlisted path throws), and tests/film-page.test.mjs fails if a listed path goes unused. The receipt's shape is CC1's (ryagram/sequence/render.py, ryagram/maprace/provenance.py): this file is meant to be the one list both sides test against. 'top' paths are from the receipt root; 'clip' paths are from each entry of receipt.clips. '[]' marks an array.
